title: ChatHealthy Normalized Indication Map
description: One document per indication in the Normalized Indication Map collection (EPIC-010-F-007). The hierarchy disease_class (CCSR body-system superclass) over parent_indication (CCSR clinical category) over member ICD-10-CM leaf codes is adopted from the published ICD-10-CM and CCSR vocabularies, not manufactured. molecule -> indication and ICD-10 -> indication associations are mined from coded sources (the Medicare Coverage Database ICD-10 lists and the UMLS crosswalks); each entry records the coded source it came from in justification_source. The embedded arrays carry multikey indexes for reverse lookup.

trust.description: 0..1 confidence; present only on residual-LLM facts (the inference's avg logprobs), absent/null on deterministic facts
